scope: Japanese KEIRIN velodrome circumference categories; preserve raw source measurement/serialization on every race record and never coerce one true circumference class into another.

official_category_authority.verified_statement: KEIRIN.JP identifies four Japanese keirin bank-lap length types: 333.3m, 335m, 400m, and 500m.

lanes.raw_source_value_policy: Preserve the source value exactly. Existing PRE artifacts may use nominal 333 or 333.33-style serialization; do not numerically overwrite the raw field.
lanes.research_handling: Continue PRE/outcome accumulation inside this circumference class; retain raw authoritative serialization per record.

lanes.raw_source_value_policy: Preserve 335 exactly; never coerce to the 333.3m class.
lanes.research_handling: Capture clean PRE and outcomes in the 335m lane. B1a winner prediction may be evaluated where its frozen contract is satisfied, but the current 333/400 circumference challenger and its dependent gate/required-odds chain must not be represented as 335m-supported. Build a 335m-specific challenger from same-length evidence.
Continue frozen 400m circumference challenger plus PRE/outcome accumulation.

Capture clean PRE and outcomes in the 500m lane. B1a winner prediction may be evaluated where its frozen contract is satisfied, but the current 333/400 circumference challenger and its dependent gate/required-odds chain must not be represented as 500m-supported. Build a 500m-specific challenger from same-length evidence.

unsupported_or_new_length_behavior.action: If an authoritative future KEIRIN source exposes a new circumference category, preserve it exactly and create a new lane before model use.

next_actions: Backfill existing repository PRE evidence into the four exact circumference lanes without changing source values.
Prioritize genuine prospective PRE capture for 335m and 500m races to start same-length validation sets.
Derive 335m-specific and 500m-specific circumference challengers only after sufficient same-length PRE evidence exists; keep the current 333/400 challenger frozen.
